Class TuiDeckInspector

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.tui.game.TuiDeckInspector
public final class TuiDeckInspector extends Object
Bottom-area overlay (toggled with the C key) that shows one player's full collection as card boxes. Owns its own navigation state — open flag, selected player and horizontal scroll offset — so the screen no longer carries it. ↑/↓ switch player, A/D scroll, Q/E jump to the ends.
